name: Personnel
definition: Events or states describing a person's job, title, social role, or relationship to others.

name: Life_Event
definition: Events related to personal milestones such as marriage, divorce, or engagement.

name: Conflict
definition: Events involving physical conflict, violence, protests, or legal arrests.

name: Transaction
definition: Events involving the transfer of money, goods, or services.

name: Arts_Media
definition: Events involving artistic performance, broadcasting, or the creation of media artifacts.

name: Communication
definition: Events where information is conveyed between entities through speech or writing.

name: Movement
definition: Events describing the physical movement or transportation of entities.

name: Competition
definition: Events involving sports contests, victories, defeats, or awards.

name: Employment
definition: Events related to professional activities, employment status, or work.

name: Education
definition: Events or entities related to educational institutions, degrees, or graduation.

name: Political_Legal
definition: Events related to political processes, legal proceedings, or governance.

name: Military
definition: Events specific to military operations, command structures, or service.

name: Location_Organization
definition: Events or entities denoting physical places, institutions, or groups.

name: Activity
definition: General actions, states, or cooperative endeavors not covered by other categories.

name: Reference
definition: Pronouns or phrases referring to previously mentioned events or situations.
